We need to find template that when applied retrosynthetically (i.e., reverse of forward) reproduces Peterson reaction: forward: beta-hydroxy silane -> elimination -> alkene, breaking C-Si and C-O bonds, forming C=C. In retrosynthesis, we start from alkene product (given molecule) and want to get beta-hydroxy silane precursor (with SiMe3 and OH). So functional groups broken in forward are C-C double bond formed; broken groups: C-C double bond formed, C-Si broken, C-O broken. In retrosynthesis, we need template that forms C-Si and C-O bonds (i.e., adds silane and OH). So functional_groups_broken (forward) = C-C double bonds (i.e., double bond formed). functional_groups_formed (forward) = ketones? Wait description says "ketones and trimethylsilyl groups are lost". Actually forward: starting from beta-hydroxy silane (has SiMe3 and OH attached to carbon). Elimination yields alkene, losing SiMe3 (as maybe silanol?) and OH (as water). So functional groups lost: ketones? Not sure. The description says "ketones" are lost? That seems odd. Maybe the beta-hydroxy silane derived from carbonyl (ketone) addition of silyl carbanion to carbonyl gives alkoxide then elimination yields alkene, losing carbonyl? Actually Peterson: carbonyl (ketone) reacts with trimethylsilyl carbanion to give beta-hydroxy silane, then elimination yields alkene, losing the carbonyl oxygen (as water) and SiMe3 as silanol? So forward: ketone and trimethylsilyl groups are lost. So functional_groups_formed (forward) = C-C double bonds. functional_groups_broken (forward) = ketones, trimethylsilyl. In retrosynthesis, we need opposite: we need to break C-C double bond (i.e., form it in forward) and form ketone and trimethylsilyl groups. So search criteria: functional_groups_broken = ["C-C double bonds"] (forward broken)?? Wait we want template that when applied to product (alkene) gives precursors with ketone and trimethylsilyl. So the template's forward reaction would break C-C double bond (since product is alkene) and form ketone and trimethylsilyl. So functional_groups_broken = ["C-C double bonds"]; functional_groups_formed = ["ketones", "trimethylsilyl"].

We tried that search, got empty. Maybe need to specify bonds broken/formed. Bonds broken: C=C bond broken. Bonds formed: C=O (ketone) and C-Si. But functional groups maybe not captured. Let's try bonds. Need bond types: "6-6" for double? Not sure. Could try bonds_broken ["6-6"]? Not sure.

Alternatively, maybe template ID known? Could search for template that matches Peterson reaction. Could try search with functional_groups_formed ["C-C double bonds"] and broken ["ketones","trimethylsilyl"]? Let's try reverse.
